findings.detail: ~/.claude-team holds a session token that expired on 2026-09-28. Anything pinned to the Team pool fails until someone logs in interactively.
findings.title: Claude Team login expired 6 days ago
findings.action: Run claude /login against ~/.claude-team from a desktop session.

findings.detail: The live check got a 401 from the Pave endpoint. Mission Control's jobs and costs views will go stale, and the MCP connection uses the same key.
findings.title: JobTread grant key is being rejected
findings.action: Generate a new grant key in JobTread, put it in BWS Production, then restart the dashboard.

findings.detail: The BWS copy was refreshed on 9/30. The token file is from July and the live check returns invalid_grant. Two scripts read the file.
findings.title: Hotmail refresh token differs between BWS and hotmail-token.json
findings.action: Point both scripts at BWS and delete the token file.

findings.detail: Rolling 101-day token last refreshed 96 days ago. The keep-alive cron runs Sundays.
findings.title: QBO refresh token expires in 5 days
findings.action: Confirm the Sunday keep-alive ran. If not, run qbo-keepalive.sh by hand today.

findings.detail: BWS, the openclaw container env and a plaintext .env share one value (group K01). Rotating it means touching all three.
findings.title: The OpenAI key lives in 3 places
findings.action: Make BWS the only copy and inject the rest at boot.

findings.detail: Same value as BWS (group K03), stored unencrypted in two more files.
findings.title: Telegram bot token sits in a .env file and ~/.secrets
findings.action: Read it from BWS in listener.py and tg-send, then delete both files.

findings.detail: intuit.com holds books@ and the personal address. Only one of them owns the QBO company.
findings.title: Two Intuit logins in the vault use different usernames for one company
findings.action: Keep the owner login, delete or relabel the other.

findings.detail: 409 days old and nothing reads it. The OpenClaw agent reaches DocuSign through a browser session instead.
findings.title: DocuSign integration key has no consumer
findings.action: Delete the BWS secret, or build the flow it was meant for.

findings.detail: Also the only consumer, scripts/mc-sync, is disabled and its cron has been failing since last September.
findings.title: Mailchimp API key not rotated in 420 days
findings.action: Delete the script and cron, then retire the key.

findings.detail: dupCopies is 2: two items are exact copies of another by name and username.
findings.title: docusign.net has 4 vault items for 2 logins
findings.action: Merge duplicates in the web vault.

findings.detail: The n8n cloud credential cannot be read back, so it cannot be compared with the BWS secret. It may already be the stale one.
findings.title: Mailchimp key in n8n cloud has no BWS source
findings.action: Open the n8n cloud credential and re-paste the BWS value.

findings.detail: The boot script falls back silently when a Staging read fails.
findings.title: Host - Injector can see only Production, but start.sh also asks for Staging
findings.action: Decide whether start.sh should need Staging at all.
